title: Hauntboard
summary: Public message board on Ootle testnet with public threads and encrypted sealed rooms. October 31 inspection loaded six general threads, runtime 0.46.0 and a Sapient wallet option. The creator’s October 30 update adds Sapient posting alongside the browser wallet; funded extension posting remains outstanding in the creator’s evidence. Classic invitations share a key in the URL fragment; recipient invitations, a separate recovery vault and future-message rotation are also described. Old keys and plaintext cannot be revoked, wallet recovery does not restore room keys, and messages do not authenticate individual authors. Titles, fees, spent-output links, timing and network metadata remain public; accepted posts cannot be edited or deleted. The refreshed recording shows public pages and privacy documentation, with no wallet or private-room action.
cardSummary: Read public Ootle discussions or share encrypted room messages with invitations and separate room-key recovery.
creator: _squared

recording.credit: App demo — Public board and room-privacy explanation; no wallet, private-room access or posting.
